category_note: Not a clean fit for the standard category table (icons are the hero, not text/stat/chart/logo/lower-third/map/webpage/news/tweet/asset-fusion). Closest structural precedent: demand-reputation-flywheel's hand-authored sequential-state-reveal pattern (icon badge + label + glow pulse, single continuous clip).
style: Purple/black brand system — minimal line-art icon badges in a horizontal row, connected by thin drawn lines, each landing with a scale+glow activate beat, capped by one left-to-right unifying glow sweep. Icon-first, near-textless (one word per icon only).

scenes.motion: persistent bg-fill fades in once, never out (defect-avoidance: no blank-frame gap)
badge scale_punch (back.out) + glow_pulse (yoyo) then label fade_in below
connector line draws left-to-right (stroke-dashoffset) between icon 0 and icon 1, arrives just before icon 1 lands
badge scale_punch + glow_pulse then label fade_in
connector line draws between icon 1 and icon 2
badge scale_punch + glow_pulse then label fade_in
connector line draws between icon 2 and icon 3
badge scale_punch + glow_pulse then label fade_in
one left-to-right glow sweep across the row; each badge + connector re-pulses as the sweep passes it, showing one connected system
hold — no further tweens, clean cut point

shot_brief: A 7-second icon-first accent piece on the purple/black brand system. Four clean line-art icon badges (megaphone / funnel / heart / checkmark) land left-to-right across a single horizontal row, each with a quick scale+glow activate beat and a one-word label (ATTRACT / CAPTURE / NURTURE / CLOSE) fading in beneath it. A thin line draws between each pair right behind the landing, so by ~4.8s all 4 icons, labels, and 3 connectors are visible as one row. At 5.5s a single glow sweeps left to right across the whole row, re-pulsing each icon and connector in turn to read as one connected system, then holds for a clean cut. The dominant motif is sequential activation — motion carries the 'system' message with almost no text.
